notice: All records generated by nAIM are synthetic and institution-neutral.

layers.validated: Canonical records accepted by the governed data-quality gate.
layers.quarantine: Rejected rows with check-level locations recorded in the run manifest.
layers.curated: Clean business entities with transparent derived variables.
layers.marts: Star-schema dimensions, facts and query-efficient aggregates.
layers.catalogue: DuckDB views when available; compact SQLite mart fallback otherwise.
layers.manifests: Run identity, seed, configuration hash, dates, counts and validation status.
layers.demo/ground_truth: Test-only deterioration truth; never exposed through normal APIs.

identifier_policy: Identifiers are deterministic synthetic tokens and contain no PII.
